_doc: ACE-Step style bank for Tiny Sparks songs (tools/song_to_ace.py). Each song gets the next style in rotation, recorded in its song.json "ace" block so a re-run keeps the same sound. 'nursery' and 'kidspop' are the user-approved styles from the Colors Song test (Nov 2026); the vocal wording ('natural ... real singer ... studio recording') is what made the voice sound less artificial.

styles.nursery: children's song, nursery rhyme, happy, bouncy, ukulele, xylophone, glockenspiel, hand claps, light drums, natural warm female vocal, real singer, soft breathy voice, gentle vibrato, clear diction, intimate studio recording, warm acoustic mix
styles.kidspop: kids pop, sing-along, catchy, piano, acoustic guitar, hand claps, kids choir backing vocals, natural expressive female lead vocal, real singer, warm and smiling tone, studio recording, polished radio mix
styles.campfire: children's folk song, sing-along, cheerful, acoustic guitar strumming, banjo, marimba, tambourine, foot stomps, friendly warm male vocal, real singer, smiling tone, clear diction, kids choir answers, natural studio recording
styles.sunshine: kids musical theatre song, joyful, bright, piano, pizzicato strings, glockenspiel, flute, light percussion, natural cheerful female vocal, real singer, expressive and clear, kids choir on the chorus, warm studio recording
